title: Preserve QueryVariable refresh setting on v2 dashboard import
answers: Why does a query variable stop updating on time range change after importing a v2 dashboard?
Why does dashboard import reset query variable refresh to onDashboardLoad?
How to avoid losing query variable refresh configuration when remapping datasources during v2 import?
body:
Symptom: An imported v2 dashboard's query variable stops updating on time range change because its refresh setting was reset to onDashboardLoad.
Root cause: public/app/features/manage-dashboards/import/utils/inputs.ts:replaceVariableDatasources hardcoded refresh to 'onDashboardLoad' when rebuilding query variables with remapped datasources.
Fix pattern: Omit the refresh override and preserve the author's variable.spec.refresh through the spread while still clearing options to an empty array.
Constraints: Applies when remapping datasources for QueryVariables in v2 dashboard UI import; does not apply to variables referencing $datasourceVar or v1 imports.
applies: v2 dashboard UI import datasource remapping for QueryVariables
